info.title: grooph links
info.summary: Open grooph with a rhythm, a generated sight-reading exercise or a metronome setting.
info.description: grooph is a browser metronome and rhythm trainer. It draws its interface into a canvas, so it cannot be operated through the DOM; instead, build a link with the query parameters below. All parameters are optional and unknown ones are ignored. Invalid links open the app with an error message that names the problem. See https://grooph.app/llms.txt for the rhythm notation.

get.summary: Open the app with the given rhythm, exercise or metronome setting
get.description: Combine `r` (a written rhythm) or the generator parameters (`sub`, `lvl`, `bars`, `space`, `seed`), not both. `ts` on its own opens a one-measure metronome in that meter.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Link version. Use 2: `bpm` then counts quarter notes in every time signature. Without `v` (version 1), `bpm` counts the meter's beat unit (eighths in x/8, sixteenths in x/16) and is converted to quarters.

parameters.name: bpm
parameters.description: Tempo in quarter notes per minute (with `v=2`).

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: A rhythm in grooph's text notation: space-separated duration tokens (`q`, `e`, `s`, `th`, dotted `q.`, tuplets such as `t8`), `r:` prefix for rests, `>` prefix for accents, `|` between measures, optional time signature at the start of a measure. Spaces may be written as `+`.
parameters.example: 4/4 q e e t8 t8 t8 r:q | q. e q q

parameters.name: ts
parameters.description: Time signature, 1-17 beats over 4, 8 or 16. With `r` it is the default meter; on its own it opens a one-measure metronome.

parameters.name: sub
parameters.description: Generator: subdivision of the random rhythm (`3` = triplets).

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Generator: random seed. The same parameters and seed always give the same rhythm; without a seed every visit draws a new one.

parameters.name: swing
parameters.description: Swing feel in percent, 50 (straight) to 75 (dotted); 66 is the triplet feel.

parameters.name: su
parameters.description: Swing unit: `16` swings sixteenths instead of eighths.

parameters.name: click
parameters.description: Click pattern of the meter of `r` (its first measure) or `ts`: one letter per beat group, `S` strong, `M` medium, `L` soft, `-` off. 7/8 (2+3+2) has three groups, e.g. `S-L`. Default: strong on the first group, medium on the others.

200.description: The grooph web app, opened with the requested setting.
